CONTROLS.NAME: WAVE_SPEED
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When off, the waves will stand still. Could be toggled on the beat to add pulsing to the scene.

CONTROLS.NAME: DISTORTION
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add some smooth distortion to the waves.

CONTROLS.NAME: ROTATE
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add a rotational drift to the waves. Must be reset to perfectly center to get normal waves back.

CONTROLS.NAME: DRIFT
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add a directional drift to the waves. Must be reset to perfectly center to get normal waves back.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_painter
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, cycles through many different shapes that disturb the wave simulation. When OFF, take manual control using paint position.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint_position
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: auto painter MUST BE OFF. Manually move a small, pulsing paintbrush around the scene, creating a wake as it travels.

CONTROLS.NAME: logo_type
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Media MUST BE SELECTED. This changes the way the scene treats a user defined image or video. Turn on for flashing, turn off for more subtle masking.
